plan: DUMMIE PLAN V1 — Cognitive Evolution Operating Layer

claims: DUMMIE now challenges its own plans through specialized adversarial roles before execution.
Authority is strictly gated by a central contract that denies high-risk actions by default.
objections: Initial adversarial roles are deterministic and may miss subtle architectural flaws.
Policy enforcement is currently based on static path/scope strings.
decisions: Implemented physical P27/P28 runtimes and integrated them into the CLI.
Forced a human-approval gate for all mutation requests.
risks: Test path detection in DebateReview is heuristic and flags documentation outputs (acceptable noise).
evidence: End-to-end demo showing safe/unsafe request evaluation.
advanced_reasoning_summary.next_lever: P29 — TrustedWorkstationMode will provide the physical scaffold for workstation-level safety.

snowball_assessment.reason: Governance and critical thinking are now physical components of the engine, not just plans.
